newsitem.title: USA: Bridgeport, Conn gets land from Trump for baseball.
newsitem.headline: Bridgeport, Conn gets land from Trump for baseball.

text.p: Real estate magnate Donald Trump has agreed to provide the land for a minor league baseball stadium in Bridgeport, Conn..
The New York developer has turned over the former Jenkins Valve Factory to the city in exchange for one dollar cash.
Trump does win some other advantages for donating the site: he is no longer responsible for $200,000 in back taxes due on the land.
The city wants to help build a $14 million stadium on the site and attract a team from the fledgling Atlantic League of Professional Baseball Clubs.
A Trump spokesman says the developer has his own plans for the city, and will soon submit a proposal to help develop Bridgeport's waterfront.
